accepted_evidence_packet.publisher: Economic and Social Research Institute, Cabinet Office, Government of Japan
supported_facts: Real GDP rose 0.3% quarter on quarter and 1.1% at an annualized rate.
Domestic demand fell 0.2% and subtracted 0.2 percentage point from GDP growth.
Net exports contributed 0.5 percentage point; exports rose 0.5% and imports fell 1.5%.
The release alone does not establish a Bank of Japan policy decision or a durable change in the growth trend.
